item.description: Travel may be disrupted until Monday morning in areas including most of southern England and across Midlands The Met Office has said weather conditions in the UK are creating a “perfect recipe” for fog as it warned that travel may be disrupted. item.title: Ohio man keeps premarital home as court upholds $20,000 legal-fee award against ex-wife
item.description: The Ohio Court of Appeals has upheld that a husband retains ownership of his pre-marriage house, resisting claims from his ex-wife. Moreover, the court ordered his ex-spouse to cover $20,000 in legal fees, highlighting the tensions caused by her legal maneuvers throughout their prolonged dispute. item.description: Five of seven facilities in England and Wales never reached operational stage as Tories vacillated over plans to check goods The UK wasted at least £100m in taxpayers’ money to set up zombie Brexit border inspection posts that were never used, it has been revealed. The overall cost of Brexit was put at an estimated £4.7bn by the National Audit Office last year but this included years-long transformation of the software used for customs declarations and other systems built to cope with the UK leaving the single market. item.title: Australia reverses military land sale plans after protests, saving four historic sites
item.description: The Australian government has opted to retain four significant historical military sites in public hands, responding to widespread public dissent against their potential sale. Notably, Victoria Barracks in Sydney and other sites in Victoria will remain untouched. The government aims to find new public purposes for these locations while preserving their heritage, and part of the broader reforms includes returning certain military lands to Indigenous communities. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: In the 1830s, Americans bought tomato ketchup as medicine after a physician claimed tomatoes could treat indigestion and diarrhoea; pills made from tomato extract were sold across the country before the craze collapsed.
item.description: In the 1830s, Dr John Cook Bennett suggested that tomatoes had medicinal properties for treating digestive issues. This led to the creation of tomato extract pills sold as medicine by various entrepreneurs. The competition between manufacturers Archibald Miles and Dr Guy R. item.title: Goldie Hawn's MindUP helps 7 million children manage stress across 48 countries
item.description: Goldie Hawn established the Goldie Hawn Foundation in 2003 to support emotional awareness among children. item.title: Informe desde Antigua: muere el diputado Julio César Portillo tras tiroteo en Guatemala
item.description: El diputado guatemalteco Julio César Portillo murió tras un ataque armado en Zacapa, que también dejó tres agentes de la Policía fallecidos. El atentado ocurrió cuando hombres armados abrieron fuego contra la camioneta en la que se movilizaba el parlamentario. Este crimen ocurre tres semanas después del asesinato del exfiscal Juan Francisco Solórzano, una figura anticorrupción. El hecho ha generado conmoción en Guatemala y reavivado las preocupaciones sobre la seguridad y la violencia en el país en la antesala de su año electoral. El informe es de nuestro corresponsal Andrés Suárez Jaramillo. Fuente: France 24 - Español.
